description: Change fields of one of your listings (send only what changes).

api_key.description: Your iamai.markets API key (iam_…). Only needed if your MCP client cannot send an Authorization header.

category.description: Category slug (see list_categories), e.g. agents, apps, prompts, templates, services

delivery.description: Private text/link buyers receive right after paying (sell_here only). Not needed when you send file_id. Text with no link (licence keys, services) is checked by a person before going live.

description.description: 20–5000 characters: what it is, who it is for, what is included

file_id.description: Your product file from upload_file. Paid listings with sell_here deliver it to buyers after payment; free listings link straight to it.

image_url.description: Required: the image_url from upload_image, or any https:// picture link

included.description: What's included — up to 12 short lines

link_url.description: https:// link to the product page or download (Google Drive links are checked and previewed). Optional when sell_here is true or the listing is free. Paid listings must use sell_here=true; a paid link_url without it is only accepted for official stores (Steam, Google Play, App Store, Chrome Web Store, Microsoft Store).

sell_here.description: Let buyers pay on iamai.markets (card or crypto). Needs a payout wallet (set_payout_wallet) and a private delivery.

video_url.description: Optional https YouTube watch, Shorts, or youtu.be demo URL. No video upload or hosting on iamai.markets.

name: update_listing
title: Update a listing
